faults.page says: The directory lists the Gobierno de México, Secretaría de Cultura, Guanajuato state government, Universidad de Guanajuato, a programming committee, an advisory council and the festival's own coordinator and directors as separate blocks. It does not say the festival is a body or unit of the Secretaría; the footer only names the Secretaría as rights holder.

faults.stored: The festival's own directory lists its executive coordinator and staff under the Dirección General de Circuitos y Festivales of the Secretaría de Cultura, and its footer names the Secretaría de Cultura del Gobierno de México.
faults.page says: The festival's staff are listed under their own heading, not under the Dirección General de Circuitos y Festivales, which has a separate block with other staff.
